mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the competent authority of the issuing country, followed by sworn translation into Spanish; where apostille is unavailable, consular legalization by the Spanish Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Municipal authority, utility provider or public administration of the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial execution and integration into the notarial file; no apostille required for internal Spanish use

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives and UBOs is required before notarial execution. Screening must be run against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list under Council Regulations (EC) 2580/2001 and (EU) 269/2014, the Spanish BOE and SEPBLAC published restrictive measures, and national and international PEP databases such as Dow Jones Risk, World-Check or equivalent. Positive PEP or sanctions matches require escalation to a designated compliance officer and, where necessary, reporting to SEPBLAC under Ley 10/2010.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sede Electrónica del Registro Mercantil Central / Solicitud de Certificación de Denominación Social, available through the Colegio de Registradores de España at www.registradores.org and the RMC electronic portal at www.rmc.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in Spanish or in any language using Latin or Roman alphabet characters. Non-Spanish expressions must be transliterated into the Spanish alphabet and, if requested by the registrar, accompanied by a Spanish translation. The name must be clearly distinguishable from existing registered names, may not contain symbols or typographic marks that obstruct identification, and must not include the suffix designating the legal form 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'SL' as part of the distinctive denomination.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Palabra or expression suggesting an official registry, public authority or public interest activity
Words requiring prior ministerial or supervisory authorization under the current name-clearance regulations of the Registro Mercantil Central
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A negative name certificate, the certificación negativa de denominación social, is valid for six months from the date of issue. No administrative extension is available; upon expiry a new application must be filed. If the Registro Mercantil Central rejects a proposed denomination, the applicant receives a reasoned denial. The applicant may file a written rectification request with the Registro Mercantil Central within 15 working days, or lodge a recurso de alzada before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública of the Spanish Ministry of Justice within one month of notification. Exhaustion of administrative remedies enables subsequent contentious-administrative review before the Audiencia Nacional.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. A virtual office may be used for commercial correspondence and administrative notifications, but the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada must maintain a real physical registered office in Spain where the effective administration or principal establishment is located or which is otherwise validly connected to the company's corporate seat. A mere mailbox or virtual address without physical substance is not sufficient for tax residence and may trigger an audit by the Agencia Tributaria.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate for a standard-risk online retailer; quantified at approximately 15% per tax year. The Agencia Tributaria and, in exceptional cases, the Mercantile Registry or the Police authorities may carry out unannounced checks to verify the physical existence of the registered office and commercial substance, particularly where the office is shared, virtual or newly registered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; corporate registration infrastructure: Registro Mercantil Central and provincial Registros Mercantiles.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An S.L. (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada) must obtain a definitive NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal; format A + 8 digits + control letter). Procedure: (1) obtain Certificación Negativa de Denominación from Registro Mercantil Central; (2) execute the incorporation deed before a Notary; (3) file Modelo 036 (Declaración Censal de Alta) with AEAT to obtain the provisional NIF, enrol in IVA and IAE, and request the EORI customs identifier; (4) inscribe the deed in the provincial Registro Mercantil within two months; (5) exchange the provisional NIF for the definitive NIF. Foreign non-resident entities obtain a non-resident NIF (N + 8 digits + control letter) by filing Modelo 036 before any taxable event; entities established outside the EU must appoint a tax representative (Representante Fiscal) under Article 45 LGT. AEAT e-filing requires an electronic certificate (FNMT/CAMERFISMA), Cl@ve PIN, or registered power of attorney.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (worldwide taxation): the S.L. is a resident capital company subject to Impuesto sobre Sociedades (Ley 27/2014) at the general rate of 25%; newly created S.L.s may apply 15% to the first EUR 300,000 of taxable base in the first two profitable tax periods (Article 29.1 LIS). No pass-through treatment; shareholder distributions are separately taxed. Deliveries to the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla are outside the mainland VAT territory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box is recognised in Spain; classification follows mercantile form. Available elections and regimes: (i) consolidated fiscal group (Articles 64-70 LIS) requiring at least 75% direct or indirect control; (ii) reduced 15% rate for newly created S.L.s; (iii) optional SII real-time bookkeeping below the EUR 6,010,121.04 turnover threshold; (iv) OSS (One Stop Shop) election for intra-EU distance sales of goods; (v) authorised exporter and AEO status with customs authorities; (vi) participation-exemption regime (Article 21 LIS) for qualifying dividends and capital gains; (vii) hybrid-mismatch neutrality adjustments applied under Article 15 ter LIS (ATAD), which override contractual arrangements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Spain (Banco de España) as the national central bank and foreign-exchange reporting authority; the Spanish Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business (Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones) supervises foreign investment controls; euro-area exchange-rate policy is within the competence of the European Central Bank (ECB).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain is a eurozone member state; the euro is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange-control restrictions on cross-border payments or profit remittances for resident or non-resident shareholders, provided corporate formalities under the Ley de Sociedades de Capital are satisfied (audited financial statements, distributable retained earnings) and tax compliance is met (dividend withholding tax at 19% for EU residents or under treaty, if applicable). Capital account flows are subject to statistical filings to the Bank of Spain and foreign-investment registry declarations to the Ministry of Economy, but these do not constitute convertibility barriers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement, compulsory conversion ratio, or repatriation timeline exists in Spain for export proceeds. Exporters may retain any foreign currency balances. Mandatory reporting applies for all cross-border transfers involving Spanish residents when the transaction amount equals or exceeds €10,000 (or the equivalent in foreign currency), which must be declared to the Bank of Spain via the appropriate statistical Declaration of Cross-Border Payments (Declaración de Pagos Internacionales).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High viability for EU-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) that hold a Spanish passport or operate under an EU Passporting regime in compliance with PSD2 and Spanish AML Law 10/2010, provided they offer local IBAN and SWIFT sequencing. Offshore digital EMIs without an EU or Spanish license are non-viable for primary operational banking due to restrictions on correspondent account access and regulatory incompatibility with Spanish settlement and clearing systems.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL), directors are generally required to attend a physical in-branch identity and mandate verification at the appointed bank, or alternatively to grant a specific power-of-attorney to a Spanish resident who can appear in person. Remote account opening with video identification is increasingly accepted by digital-first banks and select Tier-1 institutions, but the legal representative's NIF (tax identification number) and a notarized Certified Commercial Registry extract are indispensable; the use of advanced electronic signatures is permitted under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder structure involving non-resident corporate vehicles or tax-prime jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of the constitutional and registered documents of each corporate shareholder; full chain of ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) with percentage thresholds and source-of-funds declarations; passport and NIF copies of all signatories and UBOs; a current extract from the Spanish Commercial Registry for the SL; and audited financial statements of any parent entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce model receiving fragmented cross-border payments from multiple card-scheme licensees (Stripe/Shopify)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid processing platform agreements, monthly settlement statements from the acquired-payment service providers, 3D-Secure authentication logs, cardholder chargeback and refund ratios, documented returns policy, and an internal AML/CFT risk assessment demonstrating that gross payment volume per client is low, the client base is retail-consumer driven, and abnormal patterns are absent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurrent movement between operational and capital escrow accounts with intra-group liquidity arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: An internal treasury and treasury-account-transfer policy approved by the board, intercompany loan or injection documentation with clearly identified economic rationale, invoices and underlying contracts for inventory procurement, cash-flow projections for twelve months, and annual compliance attestation under the Spanish General Treasury rules and Corporate Income Tax requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injection is made via SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident parent or shareholder to the Spanish SL's operational or capital-escrow account, using the Bank of Spain statistical purpose code 'C01' (direct investment in Spanish entities) and referencing the SL's NIF and the shareholder's NIF/TIN. Verification of the capital increase is completed via a notarial deed of capital increase and subsequent Commercial Registry filing; foreign investors may need to report the transaction to the Spanish Foreign Investment Registry (Registro de Inversiones Exteriores) within 30 days if the investor is non-EU, unless the investment falls within a sector requiring prior authorization (defense, telecommunications, media, critical infrastructure, etc.), none of which apply to e-commerce.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound settlements to manufacturers of resin filaments and hardware, the primary clearing rail is a SWIFT MT103 transfer with purpose code 'T01' (trade in goods) or 'T02' (trade in services), accompanied by commercial invoices, transport contracts, and proof of customs clearance. For orders exceeding €150,000 or where supplier terms demand financial security, a commercial documentary letter of credit (UCP600-compliant) can be opened with a Tier-1 Spanish bank, establishing payment against presentation of bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, and quality inspection certificates. All EUR-denominated transactions would clear through SEPA/TARGET2, while USD and third-currency flows settle through correspondent banking networks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Euro/USD outright forwards with maturity not exceeding 12 months executed under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a Spanish credit institution
Euro/USD or Euro/CNH FX swaps for treasury cash-flow matching, with authorization under Annex II of MiFID II and mandatory transaction reporting to the Bank of Spain

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) against emerging-market currencies (pre-eminently MXN, TRY, INR) executed through EU-authorized counterparties, subject to the existence of a genuine commercial revenue or procurement exposure and internal risk-policy approval
European-style vanilla FX options (call/put on EUR/USD) purchased to cap foreign-exchange risk, using only regulated counterparties with an investment-grade credit rating

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 100,000 euros for non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (PGC) for small entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholders must notify changes in share capital or ownership within one month; beneficial ownership register updated in Registro de Beneficiarios with Agencia Tributaria

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate for newly created Sociedades de Responsabilidad Limitada during the first two taxable periods with a positive tax base, provided a genuine economic activity is exercised and the entity has no passive/asset-holding profile; no specific ecommerce tax holiday applies. Spain permits indefinite tax-loss carryforward, subject to an annual offset cap of 70% of the positive taxable base for ordinary companies (50% for large taxpayers); the 5-year figure below is the conservative planning horizon used in internal loss-forecast scenarios.
